profile.name: PyOpticon 仪表板套接字客户端
profile.description: 用于通过套接字与 PyOpticon 仪表板通信的非物理软件组件。它供独立的 Python 脚本远程读取或设置界面部件字段、触发确认操作、在仪表板上下文中求值或执行代码，并关闭连接，常用于实验界面自动化与远程控制。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for communicating with a PyOpticon dashboard over a socket. It allows separate Python scripts to remotely read or set widget fields, trigger confirm actions, evaluate expressions or execute functions in the dashboard context, and close the connection, for experiment UI automation and remote control.

registry.name: Py Opticon Socket
registry.description: Py Opticon Socket Client是一款实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括关闭。支持Signal, Slot, do confirm等操作。
